---
Vendored locally (2026-09-25) from npm package `qrcode-generator` (latest,
downloaded via jsdelivr, minified with terser) for the per-machine QR code
feature — never loaded from a CDN, same convention as vendor/pdf.min.js.
Global exposed: `qrcode(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel)`.
